    p = subprocess.run(['platformforge', *a], capture_output=True,
                       text=True)

inv, rc1 = run('inspect', '--repo', '.')
assert rc1 == 0 and inv.get('artifacts'), 'inspect found nothing'

man, rc3 = run('capability', 'manifest')
assert rc3 == 0 and (man.get('capabilities_v2') or man.get('capabilities')), 'manifest empty'
